text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? The vibe seems a bit different than 
usual. Could it be... you've become more 
mature?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really? I couldn't really tell 
myself...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I get it. It must be your birthday, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
! Y-Yes. That's amazing... You could tell 
it was my birthday just by looking at me!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Pretty much~. And right now, I am so, so 
crave-y for some cake from the cafe by the 
station!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's correct! Incredible. And I'd 
only ever mentioned that to 
Bourbon-san...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Just a hunch, a hunch. Since we're 
here, let's go grab a bite~ It's your 
birthday, so my treat.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! Thank you so much!\nEhehe, I'm so 
happy.\nI should buy a cake to bring home 
to Bourbon-san, too!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. But I'll buy those 
too, so don't you worry~.
